items.title: Advantage Archives Inc. claimed by INC Ransom
items.summary: INC Ransom listed the US professional-services and records-archive firm on its leak site with an attack date of November 13, 2026; the victim has not confirmed it.

items.title: Leware Construction Company listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: Tracker data shows the US construction firm posted to a leak site on November 11, 2026; the group responsible is not named in public snippets.

items.title: n0n group claims unnamed US victim
items.summary: The n0n group posted an unnamed US organisation with an attack date of November 9, 2026, part of a run of anonymised 'company' listings.

items.title: Everest posts 'final notice' extortion entry
items.summary: Everest added a placeholder-titled leak entry on November 13, 2026, a pressure tactic used before naming a victim publicly.

items.title: Ransomware attacks up 23 percent
items.summary: Industry data reported in late October shows ransomware attack volumes rising 23 percent, setting the backdrop for November activity.

items.title: BlackFog State of Ransomware: October 2026
items.summary: BlackFog's monthly tally of publicly disclosed and leak-site attacks for October 2026 is the latest complete monthly roundup available.

ransomware.note: Named, confirmed November victims are thin in public reporting today; leak-site claims are unverified by the victims.

items.title: Microsoft 365 disruption, Nov 12-13
items.summary: A Microsoft 365 service disruption was logged under M365 incident numbers on November 12-13; Azure status history shows no platform incident for those dates.

items.title: Apple iCloud, App Store and Apple Pay outage
items.summary: Apple consumer services were disrupted on November 17 after an internal update; only a preliminary cause has been given.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 (London) power loss
items.summary: A utility power loss at a third-party facility hosting zone europe-west2-b caused an outage of roughly 8 hours when generators failed to start; sources disagree on whether it fell in October or mid-November.

items.title: FAA, Workday, JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines outages
items.summary: A November roundup lists major disruptions at the FAA air-traffic network, Workday, JPMorgan Chase and United Airlines between November 12 and 17.

outage.note: No confirmed major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud platform-wide outage found for the past week; AWS has published no 2026 post-event summaries.

items.title: CISA adds six KEVs incl. Chrome zero-day and Barracuda ESG chain
items.summary: On November 10 CISA added six actively exploited flaws spanning Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop, with a three-day deadline on the Barracuda ESG root RCE chain.

items.title: CISA adds GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex to KEV
items.summary: Four actively exploited flaws were added on November 9 with a November 12 deadline that also required forensic triage; GPUStack exploitation included creating a malicious backend.

items.title: CISA warns of active exploitation of Node2Shell flaw
items.summary: CISA warned that attackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell (Brotli) vulnerability.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days: KEV deadline Nov 13
items.summary: Chained Ivanti Connect Secure flaws added to KEV on October 30 reached their federal deadline on November 13; only the newest builds address the full chain and the advisory has been revised several times.

items.title: M 6.8 earthquake, 103 km NE of Lospalos, Timor-Leste
items.summary: Strong offshore quake on November 21; USGS PAGER alert green, no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 earthquake near Carhuamayo, Peru
items.summary: Shallow-region quake in the central Peruvian Andes on November 21; USGS PAGER green with the tsunami flag set on the event.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake, 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia
items.summary: Banda Sea quake on November 16; USGS PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 5.9 earthquake, 238 km SW of Yanglong, China
items.summary: November 21 quake carries a USGS PAGER yellow alert, indicating possible local damage and casualties.

items.title: M 5.3 earthquake near Comandau, Romania
items.summary: Vrancea-zone quake on November 18; USGS PAGER alert green.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh, India
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast on November 3, the second cyclone to hit there in under a week.

items.title: Brazil emergencies across 44 municipalities; Santa Catarina storms
items.summary: Brazil's Civil Defense recognised emergencies in 44 municipalities across 13 states on November 3, and Santa Catarina logged 671 storm incidents in 76 municipalities on November 4-5.

items.title: Ecuador flooding: 12 dead, 56,000+ affected
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding in Ecuador killed 12 people and affected 56,323, per early-November reporting.

physical.note: Latest non-seismic reporting found is from early November; no significant November wildfire events surfaced.
